issues.label: AOM signer's statutory qualifications
issues.why: Whether Dr. Bal met MCL 600.2912d/600.2169 requirements to sign the affidavit of merit is central to summary disposition.

issues.label: Reasonable belief standard for AOM
issues.why: Whether counsel's reasonable belief in the expert's qualifications at signing satisfies the statute despite later contrary evidence.

issues.label: Burden at summary disposition
issues.why: Whether plaintiff bore the burden to produce evidence rebutting the challenge to Dr. Bal's qualifications after discovery closed.

issues.label: Reliance on extrinsic testimony
issues.why: Whether the court could consider outside deposition, trial testimony, and LinkedIn to invalidate the AOM rather than the affidavit alone.

issues.label: Credibility versus qualification challenge
issues.why: Whether defendants' attack was an improper credibility challenge or a legitimate factual challenge to qualifications.

issues.label: Remedy for invalid AOM
issues.why: Whether an invalid affidavit of merit requires dismissal and whether with or without prejudice.

issues.label: Effect of AOM on tolling/limitations
issues.why: Whether an invalid AOM fails to toll the limitations period, potentially barring refiling.

issues.label: Dean v Tucker sanction factors
issues.why: Whether barring the substitute expert as a discovery sanction is proper under the enumerated factors.

issues.label: Leave to amend witness list
issues.why: Whether MCR 2.401(I)(2) permits substituting Dr. Hall for Dr. Bal at this stage.

issues.label: Good cause for expert substitution
issues.why: Whether plaintiff showed genuine good cause given disputed evidence of Dr. Bal's cooperation and true motive.

issues.label: Scheduling order deadline interpretation
issues.why: Whether the stipulated amended order extended only discovery or also the witness list/expert disclosure deadlines.

issues.label: Prejudice to defendants
issues.why: Whether allowing amendment or dismissal unfairly prejudices defendants given trial timing and lost opportunity to challenge AOM.

issues.label: Voluntary dismissal requirements
issues.why: Whether plaintiff satisfied MCR 2.504(A) requiring pre-answer filing or stipulation of all parties.

issues.label: Discretion to deny dismissal without prejudice
issues.why: Whether the court properly denied voluntary dismissal without prejudice given plaintiff's lack of diligence.

issues.label: Effect of unauthorized amended witness list
issues.why: Whether filing the amended list without leave was a nullity properly stricken.

issues.label: Violation of order to depose Bal
issues.why: Whether plaintiff's failure to produce Dr. Bal by the ordered deadline justifies sanctions or supports dismissal.

issues.label: Plaintiff's diligence in prosecution
issues.why: Whether plaintiff's year-plus delay in resolving expert issues weighs against relief.

issues.label: Mootness of motion to compel
issues.why: Whether withdrawing Dr. Bal mooted the deposition, or defendants retained a right to depose him on AOM qualifications.

issues.label: Vicarious liability claims dependency
issues.why: Whether dismissal of the direct malpractice claim necessarily disposes of vicarious liability against Tri County and Beaumont.

issues.label: Standard on motion for reconsideration
issues.why: Whether plaintiff demonstrated palpable error warranting reconsideration of the adverse rulings.

issues.label: Distinguishing unavailability from disqualification
issues.why: Whether the true reason for substitution was Bal's non-cooperation or his disqualification, affecting the appropriate remedy.
